title: Gorgonzola and Dolce Tibs Pasta
description: A creamy Italian pasta dish with a sweet and savory twist, featuring the bold flavors of gorgonzola and dolce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the dolce sauce and stir to combine. Cook for about 2 minutes, until heated through.
Stir in the gorgonzola cheese until melted and well combined with the dolce sauce.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to coat with the gorgonzola-dolce sauce.
Season with thyme and serve immediately.
